डेटाबेस से जुड़ते समय टाइमआउट आ जाता है
दूर वाले डेटाबेस सर्वर से कनेक्ट नहीं होता, बस घूमता रहता है
security group mein port khola nahi shayad
firewall database port block kar raha hai

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('port', 'socket', 'bind_address', 'skip_networking', 'hostname')
diagnose.look_for: skip_networking ON or bind_address 127.0.0.1 means no other machine can connect; the port the app must use

diagnose.sql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('listen_addresses', 'port', 'unix_socket_directories', 'max_connections')
diagnose.look_for: listen_addresses 'localhost' accepts only local connections; the port the app must use

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('connect_timeout', 'skip_name_resolve')
diagnose.look_for: a very small connect_timeout on a slow link; skip_name_resolve OFF makes every login wait for a DNS lookup

diagnose.sql: SELECT name, setting, unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('authentication_timeout', 'tcp_keepalives_idle')
diagnose.look_for: authentication_timeout too short for slow links

causes.title_en: A firewall / cloud security group drops the database port from your IP
causes.title_hi: Firewall / cloud security group aapke IP se database port ko block karta hai

causes.title_en: Wrong or private address (private IP from outside the network, old IP after a server move)
causes.title_hi: Galat ya private address (network ke bahar se private IP, server shift hone ke baad purana IP)

causes.title_en: Server too busy to answer (CPU 100%, out of memory, slow DNS lookup on login)
causes.title_hi: Server itna busy hai ki jawab nahi de pata (CPU 100%, memory khatam, login par slow DNS lookup)

fixes.steps_en: Allow the database port only from your app server / office IP in the firewall or cloud security group; or use an SSH tunnel instead of opening the port.
fixes.steps_hi: Firewall ya cloud security group mein database port sirf app server / office IP ke liye kholo; ya port kholne ki jagah SSH tunnel use karo.

fixes.steps_en: Use the public endpoint (or VPN) from outside, the private IP from inside; update the app config after any server move.
fixes.steps_hi: Bahar se public endpoint (ya VPN), andar se private IP use karo; server shift ke baad app config update karo.

fixes.steps_en: Check the server's CPU/RAM and the Live tab; on MySQL consider skip_name_resolve (then accounts must use IPs, not host names).
fixes.steps_hi: Server ka CPU/RAM aur Live tab dekho; MySQL par skip_name_resolve socho (tab accounts mein host name ki jagah IP chahiye).

verify.en: Connecting from the app's machine takes under a second, every time.
verify.hi: App ki machine se connect hamesha ek second se kam mein hota hai.

test_phrases: the database just keeps loading and never connects from home

title_hi: Local MySQL server se socket ke through connect nahi ho raha
symptoms: ERROR 2002 Can't connect to local MySQL server through socket '/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock'
mysqld.sock not found

मायएसक्यूएल सॉकेट फाइल नहीं मिल रही
लोकल मायएसक्यूएल से सॉकेट वाली एरर आ रही है
mysql socket error after installing on ubuntu

mysql sock file gayab hai server pe
मायएसक्यूएल की sock फाइल गायब है

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('socket', 'port', 'skip_networking')
diagnose.look_for: the real socket path the server created; the client/PHP must use the same path (or connect with 127.0.0.1 over TCP)

causes.title_en: MySQL/MariaDB is not running, so the socket file does not exist
causes.title_hi: MySQL/MariaDB chal hi nahi raha, isliye socket file bani hi nahi

causes.title_en: Client and server use different socket paths (php.ini mysqli.default_socket, my.cnf [client])
causes.title_hi: Client aur server alag socket path use kar rahe hain (php.ini mysqli.default_socket, my.cnf [client])

causes.title_en: The socket directory (/var/run/mysqld) is missing or has wrong permissions
causes.title_hi: Socket folder (/var/run/mysqld) hai hi nahi ya permission galat hai

fixes.steps_en: Start the service and read the error log for why it stopped.
fixes.steps_hi: Service start karo aur error log padho ki kyun band hua.

fixes.steps_en: Set the same socket path in my.cnf [client] / php.ini as the server's socket variable, or use host 127.0.0.1 so the client uses TCP instead.
fixes.steps_hi: my.cnf [client] / php.ini mein wahi socket path do jo server ka socket variable hai, ya host 127.0.0.1 do taaki TCP use ho.

fixes.steps_en: Recreate the directory owned by the mysql user (e.g. mkdir -p /var/run/mysqld && chown mysql:mysql) and restart.
fixes.steps_hi: Folder dobara banao mysql user ke naam (jaise mkdir -p /var/run/mysqld && chown mysql:mysql) aur restart karo.

verify.en: mysql -u user -p and the app both connect with host 'localhost'.
verify.hi: mysql -u user -p aur app dono 'localhost' se connect hote hain.

test_phrases: mysql on my own server says the sock file is not there

title_en: MySQL server has gone away / Lost connection during query
title_hi: MySQL server has gone away / query ke beech connection toot gaya
symptoms: MySQL server has gone away
Lost connection to MySQL server during query
Lost connection to MySQL server at 'reading initial communication packet'
import of a big sql file stops with server has gone away
Packet for query is too large max_allowed_packet
after some time idle the app loses the mysql connection
cron job ke beech mysql connection chala jata hai
badi sql file import karte waqt gone away aata hai
raat bhar idle rehne ke baad pehli request fail hoti hai
The client was disconnected by the server because of inactivity
मायएसक्यूएल सर्वर गायब हो गया एरर
क्वेरी चलते चलते कनेक्शन टूट जाता है
bada data insert karte hi connection toot jata hai

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('wait_timeout', 'interactive_timeout', 'max_allowed_packet', 'net_read_timeout', 'net_write_timeout', 'connect_timeout')
diagnose.look_for: wait_timeout shorter than how long the app keeps an idle connection; max_allowed_packet smaller than your biggest row / INSERT

diagnose.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Uptime', 'Aborted_connects', 'Aborted_clients', 'Connection_errors_max_connections', 'Connection_errors_internal', 'Connection_errors_peer_address')
diagnose.look_for: a small Uptime (seconds) means the server restarted recently (crash / out of memory); rising Aborted_* counters

diagnose.sql: SELECT ID, USER, HOST, COMMAND, TIME, STATE FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE COMMAND = 'Sleep' ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 20
diagnose.look_for: connections sleeping for a long time: the app holds them open and the server will close them at wait_timeout

causes.title_en: The connection sat idle longer than wait_timeout and the server closed it
causes.title_hi: Connection wait_timeout se zyada der idle raha aur server ne band kar diya

causes.title_en: A query or row is bigger than max_allowed_packet (big imports, images in BLOBs)
causes.title_hi: Query ya row max_allowed_packet se badi hai (bade import, BLOB mein images)

causes.title_en: The server restarted or crashed in the middle (out of memory, killed), see a small Uptime
causes.title_hi: Server beech mein restart/crash hua (memory khatam, kill hua), Uptime chhota dikhega

causes.title_en: A long query hit net_read/write_timeout or was killed (KILL, max_execution_time, proxy timeout)
causes.title_hi: Lambi query net_read/write_timeout se takrayi ya kill hui (KILL, max_execution_time, proxy timeout)

fixes.steps_en: Make the app reconnect / ping before use (pool 'test on borrow', Laravel/Django reconnect), close connections when done; raise wait_timeout only moderately.
fixes.steps_hi: App ko use se pehle ping/reconnect karne do (pool 'test on borrow', Laravel/Django reconnect), kaam ke baad connection band karo; wait_timeout thoda hi badhao.

fixes.steps_en: Raise max_allowed_packet on the server and the client (e.g. 64M) for the import, or split the import into smaller INSERTs.
fixes.steps_hi: Server aur client dono par max_allowed_packet badhao (jaise 64M), ya import ko chhote INSERTs mein todo.

fixes.steps_en: Read the server error log around the time; if it was killed for memory, lower buffer sizes/max_connections or add RAM.
fixes.steps_hi: Us time ka server error log padho; agar memory ki wajah se kill hua to buffer sizes/max_connections kam karo ya RAM badhao.

fixes.steps_en: Find the slow query (Live tab / slow log) and speed it up; raise net_read_timeout/net_write_timeout only for known big jobs.
fixes.steps_hi: Slow query dhoondo (Live tab / slow log) aur tez karo; net_read_timeout/net_write_timeout sirf pata bade jobs ke liye badhao.

verify.en: The job / import that failed runs to the end, and Uptime keeps growing (no restarts).
verify.hi: Jo job / import fail hota tha woh poora chalta hai, aur Uptime badhta rehta hai (koi restart nahi).

title_en: PostgreSQL: server closed the connection unexpectedly / terminating connection
title_hi: PostgreSQL: server ne achanak connection band kar diya
symptoms: server closed the connection unexpectedly. This probably means the server terminated abnormally
FATAL: terminating connection due to administrator command
terminating connection due to idle-in-transaction timeout
terminating connection due to idle-session timeout
SSL SYSCALL error: EOF detected
connection to server was lost
psycopg2 OperationalError server closed the connection
postgres connection drop ho jata hai thodi der baad
load balancer ke peeche postgres connection idle hone par kat jata hai
postgres ne achanak connection kaat diya
पोस्टग्रेस ने अचानक कनेक्शन बंद कर दिया
थोड़ी देर खाली रहने पर पोस्टग्रेस कनेक्शन कट जाता है
the database connection resets after a few minutes of no activity
postgres drops my app's connection randomly
postgres beech beech mein connection kaat deta hai
पोस्टग्रेस बीच बीच में ऐप का कनेक्शन तोड़ देता है
postgres hangs up the line in the middle of work
postgres keeps cutting off my app for no reason
postgres keeps disconnecting my app suddenly
my app gets kicked off postgres without warning

diagnose.sql: SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time() AS started_at, now() - pg_postmaster_start_time() AS running_for
diagnose.look_for: a recent start time means the server restarted (crash, out of memory, update)

diagnose.sql: SELECT name, setting, unit FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('idle_session_timeout', 'idle_in_transaction_session_timeout', 'statement_timeout', 'tcp_keepalives_idle', 'tcp_keepalives_interval', 'tcp_keepalives_count', 'authentication_timeout')
diagnose.look_for: non-zero idle timeouts that close connections the app still thinks are open; keepalives 0 = OS default

diagnose.sql: SELECT datname, sessions, sessions_abandoned, sessions_fatal, sessions_killed FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()
diagnose.look_for: sessions_killed (an admin or timeout ended them), sessions_abandoned (the network dropped them), sessions_fatal (errors) growing; PostgreSQL 14+

diagnose.sql: SELECT pid, usename, client_addr, state, now() - state_change AS idle_for FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state LIKE 'idle%' ORDER BY state_change LIMIT 20
diagnose.look_for: connections idle for a long time: a firewall/NAT/load balancer may silently drop them

causes.title_en: A server process crashed and PostgreSQL restarted all connections (out of memory killer, bug, disk full)
causes.title_hi: Ek server process crash hua aur PostgreSQL ne saare connection restart kiye (OOM killer, bug, disk full)

causes.title_en: idle_session_timeout / idle_in_transaction_session_timeout / statement_timeout ended the session
causes.title_hi: idle_session_timeout / idle_in_transaction_session_timeout / statement_timeout ne session band kiya

causes.title_en: A firewall, NAT, proxy or cloud load balancer drops idle TCP connections
causes.title_hi: Firewall, NAT, proxy ya cloud load balancer idle TCP connection gira deta hai

causes.title_en: Someone or a tool ran pg_terminate_backend / a restart or failover happened
causes.title_hi: Kisi ne ya kisi tool ne pg_terminate_backend chalaya / restart ya failover hua

fixes.steps_en: Read the PostgreSQL log at that time ('server process was terminated by signal 9' = out of memory); lower work_mem/max_connections or add RAM.
fixes.steps_hi: Us time ka PostgreSQL log padho ('terminated by signal 9' = memory khatam); work_mem/max_connections kam karo ya RAM badhao.

fixes.steps_en: Commit transactions quickly, don't leave sessions 'idle in transaction'; let the pool validate connections before use; set timeouts per role if needed.
fixes.steps_hi: Transactions jaldi commit karo, sessions ko 'idle in transaction' mat chhodo; pool ko use se pehle connection check karne do; zarurat ho to timeouts role ke hisaab se set karo.

fixes.steps_en: Turn on TCP keepalives (tcp_keepalives_idle on the server or keepalives_idle in the client) shorter than the proxy's idle limit; set the pool's max idle/lifetime below it.
fixes.steps_hi: TCP keepalives on karo (server par tcp_keepalives_idle ya client mein keepalives_idle) proxy ki idle limit se chhota; pool ka max idle/lifetime usse kam rakho.

fixes.steps_en: Check the log for 'terminating connection due to administrator command' and who ran it (cron jobs, monitoring, failover).
fixes.steps_hi: Log mein 'terminating connection due to administrator command' dekho aur kisne chalaya (cron, monitoring, failover).

verify.en: No 'closed unexpectedly' errors for a day, and the start time / sessions_killed stay unchanged.
verify.hi: Ek din tak 'closed unexpectedly' error nahi, aur start time / sessions_killed same rehte hain.

test_phrases: postgres keeps hanging up on my app out of nowhere
postgres bina wajah meri app ka connection kaat deta hai

title_en: PostgreSQL says the database system is starting up / in recovery mode / shutting down
title_hi: PostgreSQL bolta hai database start ho raha hai / recovery mode mein hai / band ho raha hai
symptoms: FATAL: the database system is starting up
FATAL: the database system is in recovery mode
FATAL: the database system is shutting down
the database system is not yet accepting connections
postgres stuck in recovery mode
database recovery mode mein atka hua hai
postgres start ho raha hai bolta rehta hai
after a crash postgres says recovery
डेटाबेस रिकवरी मोड में अटका हुआ है
पोस्टग्रेस कहता है अभी शुरू हो रहा है
consistent recovery state has not been yet reached
postgres won't let me log in, says it's still starting
postgres says it is booting and refuses logins
postgres is still coming up after restart, can't log in
postgres abhi start ho raha hai bol ke login nahi karne deta

diagnose.sql: SELECT pg_is_in_recovery() AS is_standby
diagnose.look_for: true on a standby/replica (normal) or while a crash recovery is still replaying

diagnose.sql: SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time() AS started_at, now() - pg_postmaster_start_time() AS running_for
diagnose.look_for: a recent start time means the server restarted (crash, out of memory, update)

causes.title_en: PostgreSQL crashed and is replaying its WAL before accepting connections (can take minutes on big/busy servers)
causes.title_hi: PostgreSQL crash hua aur connection lene se pehle WAL replay kar raha hai (bade server par minute lag sakte hain)

causes.title_en: You connected to a standby that is still catching up or has hot_standby off
causes.title_hi: Aap standby se jude ho jo abhi catch up kar raha hai ya hot_standby off hai

causes.title_en: It keeps crashing and restarting (out of memory, disk full, corrupted file)
causes.title_hi: Baar baar crash aur restart ho raha hai (memory khatam, disk full, kharab file)

fixes.steps_en: Wait and watch the log: 'database system is ready to accept connections' means done. Don't delete WAL (pg_wal) files to speed it up.
fixes.steps_hi: Rukiye aur log dekhiye: 'database system is ready to accept connections' aaya to ho gaya. Jaldi ke liye WAL (pg_wal) files kabhi mat mitao.

fixes.steps_en: Point writes to the primary; on the standby keep hot_standby = on so reads work once it is consistent.
fixes.steps_hi: Writes primary par bhejo; standby par hot_standby = on rakho taaki consistent hone ke baad reads chalein.

fixes.steps_en: Read the log for the first error before the restart (out of memory, 'No space left on device', 'invalid page'); fix that cause first.
fixes.steps_hi: Restart se pehle wali pehli error log mein dekho (memory, 'No space left on device', 'invalid page'); pehle wahi theek karo.

verify.en: Connections work and the start time stops changing.
verify.hi: Connection chalte hain aur start time badalna band ho jata hai.

test_phrases: postgres wont let me in, keeps saying it is still booting up
postgres andar nahi aane deta, bolta hai abhi recover kar raha hoon
पोस्टग्रेस अंदर नहीं आने देता, कहता है अभी रिकवर कर रहा हूं

title_en: Connection rejected because SSL/TLS is required (or the SSL handshake fails)
title_hi: SSL/TLS zaroori hai isliye connection reject (ya SSL handshake fail)

causes.title_en: The server (or cloud provider) requires TLS and the app connects without it
causes.title_hi: Server (ya cloud provider) TLS maangta hai aur app bina TLS ke connect karti hai

causes.title_en: The app doesn't trust the server's certificate (provider CA bundle not installed, self-signed cert)
causes.title_hi: App server ka certificate trust nahi karti (provider ka CA bundle install nahi, self-signed cert)

causes.title_en: The app asks for SSL but the server has no TLS set up
causes.title_hi: App SSL maangti hai par server par TLS set hi nahi

fixes.steps_en: Turn TLS on in the app's connection: sslmode=require (PostgreSQL), ssl-mode=REQUIRED / PDO MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA / WordPress MYSQL_CLIENT_FLAGS (MySQL). Don't switch the server's requirement off.
fixes.steps_hi: App ke connection mein TLS on karo: sslmode=require (PostgreSQL), ssl-mode=REQUIRED / PDO MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA / WordPress MYSQL_CLIENT_FLAGS (MySQL). Server ki requirement band mat karo.

fixes.steps_en: Download the provider's CA certificate (RDS, Azure, Google Cloud docs) and point the client to it (sslrootcert / ssl-ca) with verify-full / VERIFY_IDENTITY.
fixes.steps_hi: Provider ka CA certificate download karo (RDS, Azure, Google Cloud docs) aur client ko uska path do (sslrootcert / ssl-ca), verify-full / VERIFY_IDENTITY ke saath.

fixes.steps_en: Add a certificate and key on the server (ssl = on with ssl_cert_file/ssl_key_file; MySQL ssl_cert/ssl_key) and restart in a quiet hour.
fixes.steps_hi: Server par certificate aur key lagao (ssl = on, ssl_cert_file/ssl_key_file; MySQL ssl_cert/ssl_key) aur shant time par restart karo.

verify.en: The app connects and the check shows Ssl_cipher / ssl = true for its connection.
verify.hi: App connect hoti hai aur check mein uske connection ka Ssl_cipher / ssl = true dikhta hai.

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('default_authentication_plugin', 'authentication_policy', 'version', 'version_comment')
diagnose.look_for: MySQL 8.0 defaults new users to caching_sha2_password; 8.4 disables mysql_native_password unless enabled; MariaDB uses mysql_native_password/ed25519

diagnose.sql: SELECT PLUGIN_NAME, PLUGIN_STATUS FROM information_schema.PLUGINS WHERE PLUGIN_TYPE = 'AUTHENTICATION' ORDER BY PLUGIN_NAME
diagnose.look_for: which login methods this server can use

diagnose.sql: SELECT USER() AS you_connected_as, CURRENT_USER() AS account_matched
diagnose.look_for: the account the server matched for this login

causes.title_en: The app's driver is too old for caching_sha2_password (old PHP mysqlnd, old Node mysql, old connectors)
causes.title_hi: App ka driver caching_sha2_password ke liye bahut purana hai (purana PHP mysqlnd, Node mysql, connectors)

causes.title_en: caching_sha2_password needs TLS or the server's RSA public key on the first login (allowPublicKeyRetrieval / get-server-public-key)
causes.title_hi: caching_sha2_password ko pehle login par TLS ya server ki RSA public key chahiye (allowPublicKeyRetrieval / get-server-public-key)

causes.title_en: The account uses mysql_native_password, which MySQL 8.4 disables by default and 9.0 removed
causes.title_hi: Account mysql_native_password use karta hai, jo MySQL 8.4 mein default band hai aur 9.0 mein hata diya gaya

fixes.steps_en: Upgrade the driver (PHP 7.4+ mysqlnd, mysql2 for Node, Connector/J 8+, latest PyMySQL/mysqlclient). This is the lasting fix.
fixes.steps_hi: Driver upgrade karo (PHP 7.4+ mysqlnd, Node ke liye mysql2, Connector/J 8+, latest PyMySQL/mysqlclient). Yahi pakka fix hai.

fixes.steps_en: Connect over TLS, or allow the client to fetch the server public key (allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true / --get-server-public-key) on trusted networks only.
fixes.steps_hi: TLS se connect karo, ya sirf bharosemand network par client ko server public key lene do (allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true / --get-server-public-key).

fixes.steps_en: Move the account to caching_sha2_password (ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED WITH caching_sha2_password BY '...') and update the app's driver; enable mysql_native_password on 8.4 only as a short bridge.
fixes.steps_hi: Account ko caching_sha2_password par le jao (ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED WITH caching_sha2_password BY '...') aur app ka driver update karo; 8.4 par mysql_native_password sirf thode time ke liye on karo.

diagnose.sql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('listen_addresses', 'port', 'password_encryption', 'ssl')
diagnose.look_for: listen_addresses must include the network the client comes from; password_encryption (scram-sha-256) must match the method in pg_hba.conf

diagnose.sql: SELECT a.usename, a.datname, a.client_addr, s.ssl FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_stat_ssl s USING (pid) WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
diagnose.look_for: which user/database/address/SSL combinations already work: the failing one needs a matching line

causes.title_en: No pg_hba.conf line matches this user + database + client address (+ SSL)
causes.title_hi: pg_hba.conf mein is user + database + client address (+ SSL) ki koi line nahi

causes.title_en: Local login uses 'peer'/'ident', which needs the Linux user name to equal the database user
causes.title_hi: Local login 'peer'/'ident' use karta hai, jisme Linux user ka naam database user jaisa hona chahiye

causes.title_en: pg_hba.conf was edited but not reloaded, or the wrong file was edited
causes.title_hi: pg_hba.conf badli par reload nahi ki, ya galat file badli

fixes.steps_en: Add one narrow line for the app: host <db> <user> <app_ip>/32 scram-sha-256 (hostssl if SSL is required). Never 0.0.0.0/0 with trust.
fixes.steps_hi: App ke liye ek tight line jodo: host <db> <user> <app_ip>/32 scram-sha-256 (SSL zaroori ho to hostssl). Kabhi 0.0.0.0/0 ke saath trust mat likho.

fixes.steps_en: Connect with -h 127.0.0.1 to use password login, or run as the matching OS user (sudo -u postgres psql), or change that local line to scram-sha-256.
fixes.steps_hi: Password login ke liye -h 127.0.0.1 se connect karo, ya same naam wale OS user se chalao (sudo -u postgres psql), ya us local line ko scram-sha-256 karo.

fixes.steps_en: Run SHOW hba_file as a superuser to find the real file, then SELECT pg_reload_conf() (or systemctl reload postgresql); lines are read top to bottom, first match wins.
fixes.steps_hi: Superuser se SHOW hba_file chala kar asli file dhoondo, phir SELECT pg_reload_conf() (ya systemctl reload postgresql); lines upar se neeche padhi jaati hain, pehli match jeetti hai.

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('max_user_connections', 'max_connections')
diagnose.look_for: a non-zero max_user_connections caps every account (shared hosting often sets 10-30); per-account limits live in the account itself

diagnose.sql: SELECT USER, HOST, COUNT(*) AS connections, SUM(COMMAND = 'Sleep') AS sleeping FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY USER, HOST ORDER BY connections DESC
diagnose.look_for: how many connections this user holds and how many just sleep (needs PROCESS to see other users)

diagnose.look_for: roles with a CONNECTION LIMIT and how close they are

diagnose.sql: SELECT datname, datconnlimit, datallowconn FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate ORDER BY datname
diagnose.look_for: databases with their own CONNECTION LIMIT

causes.title_en: The app keeps connections open and idle (persistent connections, no pool, crons overlapping)
causes.title_hi: App connection khule aur idle rakhti hai (persistent connections, pool nahi, cron overlap)

causes.title_en: The per-user limit (set by you or the host) is lower than the real need
causes.title_hi: Per-user limit (aapki ya host ki lagayi) asli zaroorat se kam hai

causes.title_en: Bot / crawler traffic opens many PHP workers at once, each with its own connection
causes.title_hi: Bot / crawler traffic ek saath kai PHP workers kholta hai, har ek ka apna connection

fixes.steps_en: Turn off persistent connections (mysqli p:, PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT), close connections after each request, use one small pool; stop overlapping crons.
fixes.steps_hi: Persistent connections band karo (mysqli p:, PDO::ATTR_PERSISTENT), har request ke baad connection band karo, ek chhota pool use karo; overlap hone wale cron roko.

fixes.steps_en: Raise it on purpose: ALTER USER ... WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS n (MySQL) / ALTER ROLE ... CONNECTION LIMIT n (PostgreSQL); on shared hosting ask the host or move to a bigger plan.
fixes.steps_hi: Soch kar badhao: ALTER USER ... WITH MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS n (MySQL) / ALTER ROLE ... CONNECTION LIMIT n (PostgreSQL); shared hosting par host se kaho ya bada plan lo.

fixes.steps_en: Add page caching and block abusive bots so fewer requests reach the database.
fixes.steps_hi: Page caching lagao aur faltu bots block karo taaki kam requests database tak pahunchein.

verify.en: The user's connection count stays under its limit through the busiest hour.
verify.hi: Sabse busy ghante mein bhi user ke connections limit se neeche rehte hain.

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('max_connect_errors', 'host_cache_size', 'skip_name_resolve')
diagnose.look_for: a low max_connect_errors (old default 10, now 100)

diagnose.sql: SELECT IP, HOST, SUM_CONNECT_ERRORS, COUNT_HOST_BLOCKED_ERRORS, COUNT_HANDSHAKE_ERRORS, COUNT_AUTHENTICATION_ERRORS, LAST_ERROR_SEEN FROM performance_schema.host_cache ORDER BY SUM_CONNECT_ERRORS DESC
diagnose.look_for: which IP is blocked and what kind of errors it made (handshake = half-open connections, e.g. health checks or port scans)

causes.title_en: A load balancer / monitor opens TCP connections to 3306 and drops them without logging in
causes.title_hi: Load balancer / monitor 3306 par TCP connection khol kar bina login chhod deta hai

causes.title_en: Network drops or timeouts during the handshake from that host
causes.title_hi: Us host se handshake ke dauraan network drop ya timeout

causes.title_en: Port scanners or bots hitting an exposed port
causes.title_hi: Khule port par port scanners ya bots

fixes.steps_en: Make the health check log in properly (or check a different port); raise max_connect_errors moderately.
fixes.steps_hi: Health check ko theek se login karne do (ya doosra port check karo); max_connect_errors thoda badhao.

fixes.steps_en: Unblock now with FLUSH HOSTS (MySQL 8: TRUNCATE TABLE performance_schema.host_cache), then fix the network/timeouts.
fixes.steps_hi: Abhi FLUSH HOSTS se unblock karo (MySQL 8: TRUNCATE TABLE performance_schema.host_cache), phir network/timeouts theek karo.

fixes.steps_en: Close the port to the internet (firewall: app server only), see the 'database open to the internet' playbook.
fixes.steps_hi: Port ko internet ke liye band karo (firewall: sirf app server), 'database internet par khula' playbook dekho.

verify.en: The host's SUM_CONNECT_ERRORS stays at 0 and no new blocks for a day.

diagnose.look_for: from a working login: user@host you came from vs the account it matched; accounts are user + host pairs

diagnose.look_for: which user@host accounts exist (all of them only for an admin): the app's IP/host is missing

causes.title_en: The account was created only for 'localhost', so other machines (or Docker containers) don't match
causes.title_hi: Account sirf 'localhost' ke liye bana, isliye doosri machines (ya Docker containers) match nahi hoti

causes.title_hi: App ka IP badal gaya (naya server, container, NAT) aur naye address ka account nahi

fixes.steps_en: Create the account for the app's exact IP or subnet (CREATE USER 'app'@'10.0.0.5' ... ; GRANT only what it needs), never 'root'@'%'.
fixes.steps_hi: App ke exact IP ya subnet ke liye account banao (CREATE USER 'app'@'10.0.0.5' ... ; sirf zaroori GRANT), kabhi 'root'@'%' nahi.

fixes.steps_en: Add the new address as its own account (or a private subnet like 'app'@'10.0.0.%'), then remove the old one.

diagnose.look_for: the exact names this user can see (case matters on Linux)

diagnose.look_for: the exact names; a quoted "MyApp" is case-sensitive

causes.title_en: Name typo or different upper/lower case ("MyApp" vs myapp)
causes.title_hi: Naam mein typo ya upper/lower case alag ("MyApp" vs myapp)

causes.title_en: The database was never created on this server (new server, fresh container, restore not done)
causes.title_hi: Is server par database bana hi nahi (naya server, fresh container, restore nahi hua)

causes.title_en: The app reaches a different server/port than the one that has the data

fixes.steps_hi: Check se exact naam copy karke app config (DB_NAME / DB_DATABASE / DATABASE_URL) mein daalo.

fixes.steps_en: Create the database (CREATE DATABASE) or restore the backup on this server before running migrations.

fixes.steps_en: Compare the host/port in the check with the app config; fix the host (localhost vs container name vs cloud endpoint).
fixes.steps_hi: Check ka host/port app config se milao; host theek karo (localhost vs container name vs cloud endpoint).

fixes.steps_en: GRANT the app user rights on that one database.
fixes.steps_hi: App user ko sirf us database par GRANT do.

verify.en: The app connects and the name appears in the check list.
verify.hi: App connect hoti hai aur naam check ki list mein dikhta hai.

rds endpoint galat hai shayad host nahi milta
डेटाबेस होस्ट का नाम नहीं मिल रहा
डेटाबेस सर्वर का पता गलत है शायद
db hostname not resolving after server migration
app can't find the database server name
database server ka hostname nahi mil raha
ऐप को डेटाबेस सर्वर का होस्टनेम नहीं मिलता
server name of the database not found

diagnose.sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS current_database, @@hostname AS server_host, @@port AS server_port
diagnose.look_for: the server name/port the app really reached; compare with the app's settings

causes.title_en: Typo or old host name in the app config (endpoint changed after a move/restore)
causes.title_hi: App config mein typo ya purana host naam (move/restore ke baad endpoint badla)

causes.title_en: A Docker service name used outside Docker (or a different compose network)
causes.title_hi: Docker service ka naam Docker ke bahar use kiya (ya alag compose network)

causes.title_en: The machine's DNS is broken or the private DNS zone isn't reachable
causes.title_hi: Machine ka DNS kharab hai ya private DNS zone tak pahunch nahi

fixes.steps_en: Copy the host exactly from the provider console (or use the IP) into the app config.
fixes.steps_hi: Provider console se host exact copy karo (ya IP do) aur app config mein daalo.

fixes.steps_en: Use the service name only inside the same compose network; from the host machine use localhost + the published port.
fixes.steps_hi: Service ka naam sirf usi compose network ke andar; host machine se localhost + published port use karo.

fixes.steps_en: Test with nslookup/dig on the app's machine; fix /etc/resolv.conf or VPC DNS.
fixes.steps_hi: App ki machine par nslookup/dig se test karo; /etc/resolv.conf ya VPC DNS theek karo.

verify.en: nslookup of the host returns an address and the app connects.
verify.hi: Host ka nslookup address deta hai aur app connect hoti hai.

test_phrases: my app can't even find the database server's name

title_en: App in Docker can't reach the database (localhost inside a container is the container itself)
title_hi: Docker mein app database tak nahi pahunchti (container ke andar localhost khud container hai)
symptoms: docker compose app cannot connect to mysql container
connection refused to postgres from another container on localhost:5432
app in docker can't reach database on host machine
host.docker.internal mysql connection
docker mein laravel ko DB_HOST kya dena hai
container se database connect nahi hota par bahar se hota hai
db container start hone se pehle app start ho jati hai
डॉकर में ऐप डेटाबेस से नहीं जुड़ रहा
कंटेनर से डेटाबेस कनेक्ट नहीं होता
docker compose up ke baad database connection error
inside docker my app can't see the database but outside it can
docker ke andar database nahi milta par bahar chal jata hai
डॉकर के अंदर डेटाबेस नहीं मिलता पर बाहर चल जाता है
works on my laptop but not in the container
connection refused to the database on the host machine from the app container
app can't reach the database running on the host machine
localhost pe database chal raha hai par container se connection refused aata hai
host machine wala database container ke andar se nahi milta

diagnose.sql: SELECT DATABASE() AS current_database, @@hostname AS server_host, @@port AS server_port
diagnose.look_for: the server name/port the app really reached; compare with the app's settings

diagnose.sql: SELECT current_database(), current_user, inet_server_addr(), inet_server_port()
diagnose.look_for: the address/port the server answers on; compare with the app's settings

diagnose.sql: SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('port', 'socket', 'bind_address', 'skip_networking', 'hostname')
diagnose.look_for: skip_networking ON or bind_address 127.0.0.1 means no other machine can connect; the port the app must use

diagnose.sql: SELECT name, setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('listen_addresses', 'port', 'unix_socket_directories', 'max_connections')
diagnose.look_for: listen_addresses 'localhost' accepts only local connections; the port the app must use

causes.title_en: The app uses localhost/127.0.0.1, which inside a container means the container itself
causes.title_hi: App localhost/127.0.0.1 use karti hai, jo container ke andar khud container hai

causes.title_en: The app starts before the database is ready (depends_on doesn't wait for readiness)
causes.title_hi: App database ready hone se pehle start hoti hai (depends_on readiness ka wait nahi karta)

causes.title_en: The database is on the host machine but listens only on 127.0.0.1
causes.title_hi: Database host machine par hai par sirf 127.0.0.1 par sunta hai

fixes.steps_en: Use the compose service name as the host (DB_HOST=db) and the container port (3306/5432), not the published one.
fixes.steps_hi: Host mein compose service ka naam do (DB_HOST=db) aur container port (3306/5432), published port nahi.

fixes.steps_en: Add a healthcheck to the database service and depends_on: condition: service_healthy, plus retry-on-connect in the app.
fixes.steps_hi: Database service mein healthcheck aur depends_on: condition: service_healthy lagao, saath mein app mein connect retry.

fixes.steps_en: Use host.docker.internal (add host-gateway on Linux) and let the database listen on the Docker bridge address only; allow just that subnet.
fixes.steps_hi: host.docker.internal use karo (Linux par host-gateway jodo) aur database ko sirf Docker bridge address par sunne do; sirf woh subnet allow karo.

verify.en: docker compose up starts cleanly and the app's first request reaches the database.
verify.hi: docker compose up saaf start hota hai aur app ki pehli request database tak pahunchti hai.

test_phrases: inside the container my program can't see the database but on my laptop it works

कंटेनर के अंदर प्रोग्राम को डेटाबेस नहीं दिखता पर लैपटॉप पर चलता है

title_en: The app's connection pool runs out (timed out waiting for a free connection)
title_hi: App ka connection pool khatam (free connection ke intezaar mein timeout)
symptoms: HikariPool Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms
QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out
Timed out fetching a new connection from the connection pool prisma
Unable to acquire JDBC Connection
knex Timeout acquiring a connection. The pool is probably full
connection pool full ho gaya app mein
pool se connection nahi mil raha, requests atak rahi hain
traffic aate hi app connection ka wait karti rehti hai
ऐप का कनेक्शन पूल भर गया
पूल से कनेक्शन नहीं मिल रहा, रिक्वेस्ट अटक रही हैं
database pool size kitna rakhein
when lots of users come the app waits for a free database connection
zyada users aate hi app database connection ka intezaar karti hai
ज़्यादा यूज़र आते ही ऐप डेटाबेस कनेक्शन का इंतज़ार करती है
all pool connections busy, requests waiting
app runs out of free db connections under load
when many visitors come together the site waits for a database connection slot
busy time pe app ko free db connection nahi milta
site hangs at peak waiting on the database pool

diagnose.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Threads_connected', 'Threads_running', 'Max_used_connections', 'Connections')
diagnose.look_for: few Threads_running but the app still waits = connections are held, not used

diagnose.sql: SELECT USER, HOST, COUNT(*) AS connections, SUM(COMMAND = 'Sleep') AS sleeping FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST GROUP BY USER, HOST ORDER BY connections DESC
diagnose.look_for: the app's connections: many sleeping = leaked/held connections

diagnose.sql: SELECT usename, datname, count(*) AS connections FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' GROUP BY usename, datname ORDER BY connections DESC
diagnose.look_for: how many connections the app really holds

diagnose.sql: SELECT pid, usename, client_addr, state, now() - state_change AS idle_for FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state LIKE 'idle%' ORDER BY state_change LIMIT 20
diagnose.look_for: 'idle in transaction' for long = the app took a connection and never finished

causes.title_en: Code takes a connection and never returns it (missing close / finally, open transaction)
causes.title_hi: Code connection leta hai aur wapas nahi karta (close / finally nahi, transaction khula)

causes.title_en: Slow queries hold every pooled connection so new requests wait
causes.title_hi: Slow queries saare pool connections pakad leti hain, nayi requests wait karti hain

causes.title_en: The pool is smaller than real concurrency (or many app instances × pool > max_connections)
causes.title_hi: Pool asli concurrency se chhota hai (ya kai app instances × pool > max_connections)

fixes.steps_en: Always return connections (try/finally, with-blocks, framework-managed sessions); turn on the pool's leak detection to find the line.
fixes.steps_hi: Connection hamesha wapas karo (try/finally, with-blocks, framework sessions); line dhoondne ke liye pool ka leak detection on karo.

fixes.steps_en: Find and speed up the slow queries first (Live tab, slow log); add statement timeouts so one bad query can't hold the pool.
fixes.steps_hi: Pehle slow queries dhoondo aur tez karo (Live tab, slow log); statement timeout lagao taaki ek kharab query pool na pakde.

fixes.steps_en: Size it on purpose: instances × pool size must stay under max_connections; a few connections per CPU core is usually enough; add PgBouncer/ProxySQL for many instances.
fixes.steps_hi: Soch kar size do: instances × pool size max_connections se kam rahe; har CPU core par kuch connections kaafi hote hain; bahut instances ho to PgBouncer/ProxySQL lagao.

verify.en: At peak traffic the pool's wait time stays near zero and no timeout errors appear.
verify.hi: Peak traffic par pool ka wait time zero ke paas rehta hai aur timeout error nahi aate.

test_phrases: when many people use the site at once it waits forever for a free database slot
jab bahut log ek saath aate hain to app free database connection ke liye rukti rehti hai
जब बहुत लोग एक साथ आते हैं तो ऐप खाली डेटाबेस कनेक्शन के लिए रुकी रहती है

title_hi: WordPress: Error establishing a database connection
symptoms: Error establishing a database connection
wordpress site shows error establishing database connection
wp-admin error establishing a database connection
wordpress site achanak database error dikha rahi hai
website pe error establishing a database connection aa raha hai
One or more database tables are unavailable. The database may need to be repaired
wp-config.php DB_HOST DB_USER galat
hosting change ke baad wordpress database se connect nahi ho raha
वर्डप्रेस साइट पर डेटाबेस कनेक्शन की एरर
वेबसाइट खोलते ही डेटाबेस से जुड़ने में त्रुटि दिखती है
my wordpress blog went blank with a database connection message
my wordpress site only shows a database connection error
wordpress home page pe sirf database connection error dikhta hai
वर्डप्रेस होम पेज पर सिर्फ डेटाबेस कनेक्शन एरर दिखता है
wordpress can't connect to database

diagnose.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Uptime', 'Aborted_connects', 'Aborted_clients', 'Connection_errors_max_connections', 'Connection_errors_internal', 'Connection_errors_peer_address')
diagnose.look_for: a small Uptime (seconds) means the server restarted recently (crash / out of memory); rising Aborted_* counters

diagnose.sql: SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Threads_connected', 'Threads_running', 'Max_used_connections', 'Connections')
diagnose.look_for: Max_used_connections at the limit = the site ran out of connections under traffic

diagnose.sql: SELECT SCHEMA_NAME FROM information_schema.SCHEMATA ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME
diagnose.look_for: the exact database name to put in DB_NAME

diagnose.sql: SELECT option_name, option_value FROM wp_options WHERE option_name IN ('siteurl', 'home', 'db_version')
diagnose.look_for: the site's settings are readable (tables are fine); unexpected URLs = see the hacked playbooks

causes.title_en: Wrong DB_NAME / DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD / DB_HOST in wp-config.php (after a move, a password change or a host change)
causes.title_hi: wp-config.php mein galat DB_NAME / DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD / DB_HOST (move, password change ya host change ke baad)

causes.title_en: MySQL/MariaDB is down or restarted (out of memory on a small server, disk full)
causes.title_hi: MySQL/MariaDB band hai ya restart hua (chhote server par memory khatam, disk full)

causes.title_en: Too much traffic / bots used up all connections
causes.title_hi: Zyada traffic / bots ne saare connections le liye

causes.title_en: Tables are damaged ('One or more database tables are unavailable')
causes.title_hi: Tables kharab hain ('One or more database tables are unavailable')

fixes.steps_en: Compare wp-config.php with the host's database panel; reset the database user's password there and put the same one in DB_PASSWORD. DB_HOST is often 'localhost' but some hosts give a name.
fixes.steps_hi: wp-config.php ko host ke database panel se milao; wahan database user ka password reset karo aur wahi DB_PASSWORD mein daalo. DB_HOST aksar 'localhost' hota hai par kuch host naam dete hain.

fixes.steps_en: Start the database service / ask the host; if it was killed for memory, lower its memory settings or upgrade the plan.
fixes.steps_hi: Database service start karo / host se kaho; memory ki wajah se band hua to memory settings kam karo ya plan badhao.

fixes.steps_en: Add page caching, block bad bots, then see the 'Too many connections' playbook.
fixes.steps_hi: Page caching lagao, faltu bots block karo, phir 'Too many connections' playbook dekho.

fixes.steps_en: Take a backup first, then use WordPress repair (define('WP_ALLOW_REPAIR', true); open /wp-admin/maint/repair.php) and remove the line afterwards.
fixes.steps_hi: Pehle backup lo, phir WordPress repair chalao (define('WP_ALLOW_REPAIR', true); /wp-admin/maint/repair.php kholo) aur baad mein line hata do.

verify.en: The home page and /wp-admin load, and Uptime keeps growing.
verify.hi: Home page aur /wp-admin khulte hain, aur Uptime badhta rehta hai.

test_phrases: my wordpress homepage only says it can't connect to the database
meri wordpress website khulte hi bolti hai database se jud nahi pa rahi
मेरी वर्डप्रेस वेबसाइट खुलते ही कहती है डेटाबेस से जुड़ नहीं पा रही
